blocks.text:
There is no separate class for radio buttons. Check buttons and toggle buttons
act as radio buttons when they form a group. Only one button in a group can be
selected at any one time.
blocks.zh: GTK4 中没有独立的单选按钮类。勾选按钮和开关按钮一旦组成一组（group），就具备了单选行为：同组之内任意时刻最多只能选中一个。

blocks.text:
We told gtkmm to put all three `CheckButton`s in the
same group by using set_group() to tell the other
`CheckButton`s to share group with the first
`CheckButton`.
blocks.zh: 我们通过 set_group() 告诉其余的 `CheckButton` 要跟随哪个按钮编组，从而让三个 `CheckButton` 同属一组。

blocks.text:
`CheckButton`s and `ToggleButton`s are "off"
when created; this means that when you first make a group of them, they will all be off.
Don't forget to turn one of them on using set_active().
blocks.zh: `CheckButton` 和 `ToggleButton` 在创建之初都是「未选中」状态；因此刚建好一组按钮时，它们全都处于弹起状态，没有默认选中项。
